observations.reason: no production code path exists. The participant-join recorder is called from nothing but its own test, and the live join route is an upsert that does not refuse a re-join, so no credential or window can satisfy this gate. Another lane is implementing the refusal. This is a gap between the gate vocabulary and the implementation, not an access problem.

no drill driver and no operator credential path exist. The worker control bearer is an HMAC over the canonical dispatch authority keyed by the worker control root, and no checked-in tool derives or issues one. Hand-deriving it is the unreviewable one-shot practice EP263-LK H1 replaced with a durable tool. The runbook procedure for this scenario is one sentence.
no mid-session rekey was reached and no rekey proof exists. The checked-in static end-to-end encryption key revision is configuration, and this row explicitly refuses it as a rekey proof.

no operator path exists for a bounded single-member revocation. The only executable lever accepts one literal alpha cohort ref and revokes every active member of it, with no bulk re-admit: re-admission is one npub at a time. The per-member NIP-29 path needs a kind-9001 remove-user event signed by the configured community admin pubkey, for which this repository holds no key, no Secret Manager entry, and no signing tool.

the acceptance route is contract-locked closed: the provider-disconnect flag is committed false and the handler answers 404 before authentication, so the drill cannot start without a deploy that arms the bounded window. Arming was authorized for this lane but not performed, because the drill it enables still needs a single held-open session that no driver provides, and an armed window that cannot be used is production mutation without evidence.

the eight-scope scan cannot produce a same-window complete export. One of its four blockers was cleared on 2026-07-31: the pods scope now has container log read through the granted namespace RBAC. Three remain and none is a repository change: Error Reporting is not enabled, Redis has no IAM and no read-only network path, and packaged clients, object storage, and traces have no defined target set. All eight scopes must land in one window, so clearing one buys nothing.

requires a fresh admission strictly after a previous terminal boundary with no overlapping generation. The available driver settles both of its sessions and exits, so there is no post-terminal boundary to reconnect across, and the runbook gives no executable steps for this scenario.

no procedure defines which grant is replayed or what refusal code is expected. The term appears in this repository only as this observation key, and the LiveKit runbook has no replayed-grant section. Recording a pass from an invented replay would be hand-authoring a row from expectations, which the runbook forbids.

defined in the matrix (openagents af65458919) and delete-pods authority now exists, but the precondition concurrentBillableSessionCount=1 is unsatisfiable by any tool here: the sole session driver asserts concurrent overlap and always runs two billable sessions. Pod identification is also unsolved: the runbook reads livekit_room_total via pods/exec, deliberately not granted, and the Managed Prometheus alternative scrapes every 30s against a session lasting about 21s.

no longer a permission blocker: namespace RBAC role sarah-livekit-drill-automation in livekit-system now grants delete pods and get pods/log, verified 2026-07-31 by a server-side dry-run delete. Still unexecutable because no driver holds one billable session live while the exact worker pod is deleted: the acceptance driver requires a private and a community scenario, runs both concurrently, and returns only after both settle.
